updates.title: On-chain universe
updates.summary: The scanner now merges CoinGecko meme markets with live GeckoTerminal new and trending pools and DexScreener boosts and profiles. Fresh on-chain is its own filter. Coin of the Day still ignores unlisted contracts. Not financial advice.

updates.title: Forced Coin of the Day
updates.summary: Meme projects can buy the homepage Coin of the Day for a New York day. The banner is labeled SPONSORED. An optional Fortune lock makes that day’s shared spin land on the same coin. Entertainment only — not a prediction.

updates.title: Cipher Fortune
updates.summary: Spin the wheel, land on a random coin, get today’s decoded breakdown. Free and for fun. Not a prediction. The New York date picks one shared coin, and you can spin again as a labeled bonus.

updates.title: Smart Money, explained
updates.summary: The board now counts received and swap separately, marks quiet wallets, and says plainly that a desk inflow is not a buy. Same public list. Still not a signal.

updates.title: Smart Money Watch
updates.summary: A live 24h feed of public Solana and Ethereum wallets — notable addresses and named trading desks — with an Ape Check grade on each token when the chain is ETH, BSC, Base, or Solana.

updates.title: Graded movers
updates.summary: The homepage board fills Ape Check grades on trending tokens so you can open a receipt without pasting a contract. Rows that cannot be graded are left off.

updates.title: Post this grade on X
updates.summary: Ape Check results have a button that opens an X post with the letter and the grade link, so the preview card can attach.

updates.title: Daily digest
updates.summary: One email a day: five movers, a hall grade, a shame grade, Fear and Greed when it is available, and a link to Smart Money Watch. One-click unsubscribe.

updates.title: Compare grades
updates.summary: Paste two contracts, optionally a third. The page puts the Ape Check receipts side by side and says which score is higher. The link is shareable.

updates.title: Faster market snapshot
updates.summary: The homepage can paint from a cached CoinGecko snapshot instead of waiting on five staggered requests. Refresh still replaces it with the live pages.

updates.title: Four color themes
updates.summary: OG teal and black stays the default. Voltage, Mint, and Paper are optional and remembered in the browser.

updates.title: Ape Check
updates.summary: Paste a contract and get an A+ to F safety grade, a receipt of the public checks, and a card you can share. Hall and Shame list today's best and worst grades.

updates.title: Price alert signup
updates.summary: Save an email and a price. CIPHER tries to confirm it, then emails you once when the coin crosses your number. Unsubscribe in one click.

updates.title: Top Movers
updates.summary: A daily board of 24h meme-coin gainers, losers, and volume spikes. Each row links to a coin page, and the page includes the where-to-buy referral section.

updates.title: Coin pages
updates.summary: Every coin has its own page with the live price, a share link, and a contract scan when the token is on Ethereum, BSC, Base, or Solana.

updates.title: Rug Radar
updates.summary: Tokens drawing DexScreener attention, checked with the free GoPlus security API. Open any row for a full CipherPot scan.

updates.title: Shareable scan links
updates.summary: Every CipherPot result has a link you can send to a friend, and a preview card when you share it on X.

updates.title: Signal Score
updates.summary: A written read of hype, mood, and market-structure risk. The words SEND IT, WAIT, and NGMI come from a formula over CoinGecko numbers, not from a language model.
